name: com.proceduralpixel.creations
description: Procedural pixel-art creatures, mythical creatures, monsters, trees and flora, and props: generated, animated and rasterized in code at HD pixel density, with biome variants (desert, snow, jungle, swamp, volcanic). Live PixelCreatureActor components, a Creation Studio editor window with gene editing, presets, sprite sheet export and baking to sprites, animation clips and animator controllers.

samples.description: A script that spawns a mixed crowd of creatures, mythical creatures, monsters, trees and props, with one creature you can steer (legacy Input Manager or Input System).
92 ppc.creature presets: at least six per family.
